verdict.rationale: Penpot's own docs claim native design tokens as a design-system feature, so the core token capability is first-party. But the evidence never describes token types (colors, spacing, typography) or modes/themes applied across designs. missing for 10: documented token types (color, spacing, typography), modes or themes switching across designs, in-depth token management docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can manage design tokens or variables — colors, spacing, typography — with modes or themes applied across designs

citations.quote: Open-source alternative with self-hosting, unlimited files, native design tokens.
